abilities.name: Skullstandard Planted
abilities.description: While Krennik holds the skull-stitched standard-pole, allies within 5 feet of Krennik are immune to the frightened condition, and once per turn Krennik ignores difficult terrain or stands from prone without spending movement.

abilities.name: Skirmisher
abilities.description: Krennik ignores difficult terrain, and opportunity attacks against it are made with disadvantage.

abilities.name: Mounted Agility (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: Krennik takes the Dash or Disengage action.

abilities.name: Rampage (1/Day) (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already below half its hit point maximum, Krennik moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Lance attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Krennik makes two attacks: one with Lance and one with Javelin.

actions.name: Lance
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If Krennik moved at least 20 feet in a straight line toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) piercing damage and, if it is Medium or smaller, is knocked prone.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Run Them Down (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Krennik moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space it enters is targeted once by the following effect. Each such creature must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target is also knocked prone.

generation.gap_death_sites: 1x the weld (a push that undoes its own row)
